subactions.description: Knowledge documents with ownership, lifecycle, classification, lineage and governance metadata.

subactions.schemaXml: <Field ID="{ecdc62ec-1d3c-a4d6-4769-be3770bc8ad4}" Name="ArtifactId" StaticName="ArtifactId" DisplayName="Artifact ID" Description="Stable generated artifact identifier." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" EnforceUniqueValues="TRUE" Type="Text" MaxLength="64" />

<Field ID="{f4ba0745-494d-35f9-d95e-4397f57ce36d}" Name="KnowledgeCategory" StaticName="KnowledgeCategory" DisplayName="Knowledge Category" Description="Logical retrieval category." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="Choice" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>Quality</CHOICE><CHOICE>Engineering</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field ID="{66963a4e-7182-de1c-299a-df6d0309fa7a}" Name="SourceTable" StaticName="SourceTable" DisplayName="Source Table" Description="Lineage reference. Not applicable to authored content." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="Text" MaxLength="255" />

<Field ID="{aa4cbcd0-f4bb-7cd9-f866-a2a0c421123a}" Name="SourceSystem" StaticName="SourceSystem" DisplayName="Source System" Description="System of record for the document." Required="FALSE" Indexed="FALSE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="Text" MaxLength="255" />

<Field ID="{a7248222-95f3-ca42-e2e5-0c8119b885ba}" Name="ProfileGeneratedAt" StaticName="ProfileGeneratedAt" DisplayName="Profile Generated At" Description="UTC timestamp of the source snapshot." Required="FALSE" Indexed="FALSE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="DateTime" Format="DateTime" />

<Field ID="{c3ed802f-9136-428a-13db-066ebf14d7d1}" Name="KnowledgeOwner" StaticName="KnowledgeOwner" DisplayName="Knowledge Owner" Description="Required when published. Accountable owner who approves the document." Required="FALSE" Indexed="FALSE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="User" List="UserInfo" ShowField="ImnName" UserSelectionMode="PeopleAndGroups" />

<Field ID="{b7eaa0b7-59ec-3f59-0b03-39ca7a0167e6}" Name="LifecycleStatus" StaticName="LifecycleStatus" DisplayName="Lifecycle Status" Description="Required when published. Only Published documents can become authoritative knowledge." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="Choice" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>Draft</CHOICE><CHOICE>Published</CHOICE><CHOICE>Superseded</CHOICE><CHOICE>Archived</CHOICE></CHOICES><Default>Draft</Default></Field>

<Field ID="{1fe5ea21-dac0-58a9-8ca7-1191c0dd3c0c}" Name="DocumentIteration" StaticName="DocumentIteration" DisplayName="Document Iteration" Description="Required for uploads and updates. Draft content is excluded from retrieval until promoted." Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="Choice" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>Draft</CHOICE><CHOICE>Ready</CHOICE><CHOICE>In Review</CHOICE><CHOICE>Approved</CHOICE><CHOICE>Archived</CHOICE></CHOICES><Default>Draft</Default></Field>

<Field ID="{253aa91d-46c0-8496-8296-c7ae7ad70718}" Name="Authoritative" StaticName="Authoritative" DisplayName="Authoritative" Description="Required when published. Set by the knowledge owner, never by the AI." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="Boolean"><Default>0</Default></Field>

<Field ID="{e7cfec70-da56-e2bb-d299-73ca6c5fd931}" Name="ReviewDate" StaticName="ReviewDate" DisplayName="Review Date" Description="Required when published. Content past this date is treated as stale." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="DateTime" Format="DateOnly" />

<Field ID="{bf9c0411-6fcf-77af-e73f-a238cfbb0c8a}" Name="DocumentType" StaticName="DocumentType" DisplayName="Document Type" Description="Document class used to scope conflict detection." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="Choice" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>Procedure</CHOICE><CHOICE>Specification</CHOICE><CHOICE>Test Report</CHOICE><CHOICE>Decision Record</CHOICE><CHOICE>Meeting Summary</CHOICE><CHOICE>Technical Guide</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field ID="{a71219ae-0f6c-1dc6-3049-dbcea8e6815e}" Name="ProductFamily" StaticName="ProductFamily" DisplayName="Product Family" Description="Product family (Choice for this POC; managed metadata in production)." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="Choice" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>ApexDrive X500</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field ID="{35839706-0571-f3a0-9910-3ec50bbb9c67}" Name="ProcessArea" StaticName="ProcessArea" DisplayName="Process Area" Description="Process area used to scope conflict detection." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="Choice" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>Failure Analysis</CHOICE><CHOICE>Quality Escalation</CHOICE><CHOICE>General Engineering</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field ID="{27d11003-14fc-b127-e0bf-2a60c6608e78}" Name="Sensitivity" StaticName="Sensitivity" DisplayName="Content Sensitivity" Description="Only General content may be served by the trusted agent." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="Choice" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>General</CHOICE><CHOICE>Confidential</CHOICE><CHOICE>Highly Confidential</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field ID="{8db4fda1-3bee-569f-e6a3-120b2d2c2786}" Name="EffectiveDate" StaticName="EffectiveDate" DisplayName="Effective Date" Description="Date the document became effective." Required="FALSE" Indexed="FALSE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="DateTime" Format="DateOnly" />

<Field ID="{32ec0646-6418-15cd-e6f1-c7007b3641a6}" Name="ExpirationDate" StaticName="ExpirationDate" DisplayName="Expiration Date" Description="Date after which the document must not be used as authoritative knowledge." Required="FALSE" Indexed="FALSE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="DateTime" Format="DateOnly" />

<Field ID="{749f7297-9c05-01d4-d67f-283b619fe88d}" Name="SupersedesDocument" StaticName="SupersedesDocument" DisplayName="Supersedes Document" Description="File name of the document this version replaces. Lineage links are not treated as duplicates." Required="FALSE" Indexed="FALSE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="Text" MaxLength="255" />

<Field ID="{3e169d28-d57f-9b33-e1dc-ace8c8e3fe05}" Name="BusinessUnit" StaticName="BusinessUnit" DisplayName="Business Unit" Description="Owning business unit." Required="FALSE" Indexed="FALSE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="Text" MaxLength="255" />

<Field ID="{4c8e3163-1a18-5853-6c75-73cf56fecc0f}" Name="OwnerDisplayName" StaticName="OwnerDisplayName" DisplayName="Owner Display Name" Description="System-populated display name of KnowledgeOwner, so the indexer can carry it to search." Required="FALSE" Indexed="FALSE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="Text" MaxLength="255" />

<Field ID="{6b1f4523-9231-a0a2-05fe-b8c648c3a51a}" Name="AIReady" StaticName="AIReady" DisplayName="AI Ready" Description="System-computed by the governance sync. Yes only when the document meets every trusted-retrieval rule." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="Boolean"><Default>0</Default></Field>

<Field ID="{9d1b6673-d199-04f2-e15e-a4b58687ae35}" Name="TrustScore" StaticName="TrustScore" DisplayName="Trust Score" Description="System-computed explainable score from 0 to 100. Advisory only." Required="FALSE" Indexed="FALSE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="Number" Min="0" Max="100" Decimals="0" />

<Field ID="{c6f6a104-a513-37fa-c3a3-98ec8a48d8c4}" Name="DataQualityStatus" StaticName="DataQualityStatus" DisplayName="Data Quality Status" Description="System-computed governance state." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="Choice" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>Good</CHOICE><CHOICE>Needs Review</CHOICE><CHOICE>Stale</CHOICE><CHOICE>Duplicate</CHOICE><CHOICE>Conflicting</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field ID="{6b8fdeb3-24bd-de4b-47a4-4d87ad3fe563}" Name="ConflictStatus" StaticName="ConflictStatus" DisplayName="Conflict Status" Description="System-computed conflict finding for this document." Required="FALSE" Indexed="TRUE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="Choice" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>None</CHOICE><CHOICE>Conflicting Authoritative</CHOICE><CHOICE>Conflicts With Authoritative</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field ID="{4a57a1ae-e587-29bc-7250-9e5f2ff0d9f4}" Name="ConflictWith" StaticName="ConflictWith" DisplayName="Conflict With" Description="System-computed list of conflicting file names." Required="FALSE" Indexed="FALSE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="Text" MaxLength="255" />

<Field ID="{39de5c5b-30f2-6b6f-b436-3e26f4e897fc}" Name="DuplicateOf" StaticName="DuplicateOf" DisplayName="Duplicate Of" Description="System-computed canonical file name for exact or near-duplicate candidates." Required="FALSE" Indexed="FALSE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="Text" MaxLength="255" />

<Field ID="{fb8587d0-d471-20fa-fa1c-a7096721ba40}" Name="ContentHash" StaticName="ContentHash" DisplayName="Content Hash" Description="System-computed SHA-256 of normalized document text." Required="FALSE" Indexed="FALSE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="Text" MaxLength="64" />

<Field ID="{c416b1cf-8d42-7b25-c17c-72ba1172389e}" Name="TrustReasons" StaticName="TrustReasons" DisplayName="Trust Reasons" Description="System-computed explanation of every trust score component." Required="FALSE" Indexed="FALSE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="Note" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" AppendOnly="FALSE" UnlimitedLengthInDocumentLibrary="TRUE" />

<Field ID="{96bd9a3e-d608-f73c-4b38-3900131106ef}" Name="LastValidatedDate" StaticName="LastValidatedDate" DisplayName="Last Validated Date" Description="Date of the most recent governance validation run." Required="FALSE" Indexed="FALSE" EnforceUniqueValues="FALSE" Type="DateTime" Format="DateOnly" />
